reviews.feedback: internal/store/store.go AcceptInvite (~line 512): the check `if !found || inv.RevokedAt != nil` lets an already-accepted invite token be accepted again. RemoveMember does not touch the invite, so after a member is removed their old token re-creates them via addMember with no seat check, and the org can exceed its plan limit (e.g. free plan: owner + A accepted, remove A, fill with two pending invites, re-accept A's token -> 4 seats used, limit 3). Fix: also reject when inv.AcceptedAt != nil (ideally return ErrNotFound as for revoked invites). Add a test in internal/api/seats_test.go covering accept, remove member, fill the plan, then re-accept the same token, expecting it to fail and used to stay at the limit.
